text: Adoption needs value/metrics.json (MET-nn) covering adoption, flow (PR cycle time, lead time), quality (change failure, defects, review rework), experience (survey) and cost per engineer, each with pilotTarget and guardrail, so the pilot decision gate can cite ids. Until it exists, rollout/evaluation-plan.md uses [MET-?: ...] placeholders to be resolved in Sprint 2.

S1-NAR-01 uses placeholders [MET-?: adoption - weekly active share], [MET-?: flow - PR cycle time], [MET-?: flow - change lead time], [MET-?: flow - task completion rate], [MET-?: quality - change fail rate], [MET-?: experience - developer survey], [MET-?: business - features shipped], and [ASM-?] for hours saved, adoption, realization, loaded cost, seat/usage cost, payback, break-even, sensitivity. Note: on the Bedrock/Agent Platform path usage metrics do not reach Anthropic analytics; use OpenTelemetry [CLM-658][CLM-656]. DORA names: change fail rate, change lead time [CLM-655].
